notes.title: Patch Notes Demo v0.1.6
notes.content:
Character Controls Update

Walk function added

Keyboard: Hold \[Ctrl] to walk

Controller: Lightly push the analog stick to walk

Improved character animations

Controller input layout updated



Localization Improvements

Cutscene dialogue updated

Background translation feature added

Only visible in languages other than Korean

When the 'Read' guide is activated during gameplay, background text can be translated through interaction



New languages added:

Russian

Portuguese (Brazil)

German

French

Spanish

Puzzle Adjustments

Puzzle structure and difficulty adjusted in the Seobinggo area

Tutorial section near the Hangang area improved

Other Changes

Title screen background music changed

Various bug fixes

notes.title: Development Update & Game Show Participation
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641759/9ff8dd2142540b4e3c3c827ee5be5dcad99607f1.png

Hello, players
This is JINO Games. 

It's been a while since I've posted an update. 
Today I'd like to briefly intoruce the current development status of Goodbye Seoul and its participation in upcoming game shows. 

Goodbye Seoul is now in the final stages of preparing the build for its Early Access release, with further work being done on polishing and the soundtrack. 

Particularly, I have made significant progress on story, controls, puzzles, and other elements based on the feedback from many of you who played the demo. I am eager to show you these improvements as soon as possible.

Committed to depicting the stark contrast between the dark, despairing Seoul on the brink of destruction and its final, dazzling moments — I hope you look forward to more that is to come. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641759/b8368a510b5b56f29adfca3d25d373f40b9b3907.gif

I wholeheartedly appreciate the support of everyone rooting for Goodbye Seoul, and I am constantly striving to create opportunities to showcase the game directly. 

I am excited to announce that Goodbye Seoul will be participating in the BitSummit 2024 event on July 19th. I hope that there will be many more opportunities in the future for Goodbye Seoul to meet you in person.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44641759/4b2638c85909a8162cc2ff21af2321f0e4df4081.jpg

I am always grateful for the messages of support and feedback I've received since the demo release. 

Thank you,
JINO Games.

notes.title: New Languages Support and Enhanced English Translation
notes.content:
Hello from the Goodbye Seoul Team!

We are thrilled to announce our latest update, which brings the much-awaited language support and significant improvements to your gaming experience

What's new:

Language Support
We have added support for Japanese, Chinese (Simplified), and Chinese (Traditional).
Now you can enjoy the immersive world of Goodbye Seoul in these languages, making your gaming experience more comfortable and enjoyable.

Enhanced English Translation
We've also taken a critical look at our existing English version and made extensive improvements. 
This update brings more polished and nuanced English translations across the board, ensuring a smoother and more engaging gameplay experience for our English-speaking players.
Furthermore, we've changed the English title from 'GoodbyeSeoul: Itaewon' to 'Goodbye Seoul' in order to deliver a better understanding of the game to our English-speaking audience.

Minor Improvements
 Improved animations
 Fixed minor bugs
 Added a Profanity Filter
 Changed the English title of the game
We are deeply committed to ensuring Goodbye Seoul is as welcoming and inclusive as possible. 
We’d love to hear your feedback on these new language options and any suggestions for future updates."

Thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm. 
Dive back into the richer, more inclusive world of Goodbye Seoul—and may your adventures be grander than ever.
